description: S459 LOW-4 + MED-1 legitimate twin of shared-collection-delta-reject-rt, restated for copy-in (S459 "a, go"): every write here satisfies the position it writes, so each is applied. (1) `@x = @y` stores x's own copy, so @x's tighter type (`number(>5)[]`) never constrains @y's array and `@y.push(3)` is admitted. (2) field / row writes with valid values, and a write of an unrefined field. (3) `@p.b = @p.a` stores a copy at b: `@p.a.push(9)` changes a only. (4) a valid push into a nested array.
rationale: §53.3.3: "The assignment is applied if and only if the predicate evaluates to true." A released alias is no longer a binding site of the released cell's type.
